title: Compute brief - 5 October 2026
description: Two Wire ids: Nebius signs a binding 12-year, 50 MW deal at AIB Data Centers (US), and AM Intelligence orders 20,000 more NVIDIA Rubin GPUs for India and Malaysia (~70 MW). Silicon Tape confirm day (69/0/0): Lambda H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69 / GH200 $2.29; DO B300 spot $8.00 / MI350X $2.46 / MI355X $2.97; CoreWeave H100 OD $6.16. AWS CB Oct 7 card two days out. Brookwood council vote still pending.
og_kicker: Nebius 50 MW lease; 20k Rubin for India and Malaysia
lede: Monday's conversions come from the neocloud and sovereign-compute edge rather than the hyperscalers. AIB Data Centers says Nebius signed a binding 12-year agreement for 50 MW of critical IT capacity at its southeastern US site, with Nebius prepayments helping fund the build (30 Sep, filed on Form 8-K). AM Intelligence, the Greenko promoters' AI platform, placed firm orders for 20,000 more NVIDIA Rubin GPUs for India and Malaysia, about 70 MW for Q2 2027 delivery, taking its committed total to roughly 29,000 Rubin GPUs and close to 100 MW. The public rental tape is a full six-venue confirm session after the weekend: 69 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW. Lambda holds H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69 / GH200 $2.29; DigitalOcean spot holds B300 $8.00 / MI350X $2.46 / MI355X $2.97; CoreWeave H100 OD $6.16 confirms. AWS Capacity Blocks still banners its 7 Oct rate card while the live table prints current rates (P5 Virginia $5.191). In memory, Micron's fiscal Q4 revenue of $54.23B and a $61.5B guide underline where AI value is pooling. Brookwood's City Council vote on the TCEDA-backing resolution is still pending; Applied Digital has begun baseline sound monitoring at Brookwood Middle School, with no groundbreak primary and the tenant still unnamed. Oracle's Port Washington campus faces a restarted Wisconsin PSC review of its ATC grid connection. PUCT 58481 still effective 10.08.2026; ERCOT RFI due 12 Oct; TCEQ update due 19 Oct; Fermi x TensorWave Matador due 31 Oct.
